name: Natsuki
source:
“Next time, I’ll definitely kick you out!”

She is one of the twins under Karen’s care and Riona’s younger sister. Possessing an adult-like level of drive and initiative, she is never able to sit still. Strong-willed and stubborn, she also has a soft side and is quick to tears. Though she can be a bit selfish at times, she is weak when it comes to Karen and Riona. Her glasses are her defining charm point.
